Calculate leaf wetness based on relative humidity

dot-calculate_leaf_wetness.Rd

Calculate a leaf wetness value between 0 and 1 based on the relative humidity and rainfall values in the weather data. The simple calculation uses only the relative humidity and rainfall threshold to set the value to 0 or 1 based on the threshold values. While the complex calculation uses a formula to calculate a more nuanced value for leaf wetness between 0 and 1 using a scaled value of relative humidity where values > rhlim == 1, < 95% & > 80% == (rh - 80) / 15) or < 80% == 0.

Usage

.calculate_leaf_wetness(weighted_wetness = FALSE, wth, rhlim, rainlim)

Arguments

weighted_wetness

A Boolean value indicating whether to use simple leaf wetness calculation, FALSE, or a more complex calculation, TRUE, that weights the leaf wetness value based on the relative humidity for each hour between RH rhlim and 80%, \((rh - 80) / (rhlim - 80)\). Defaults to FALSE, using the hourly rhlim value to return a 0 or 1 value.

wth

Weather data in the proper format.

rhlim

Relative humidity threshold (%) to determine if there is free water on the leaf surface.

rainlim

Rainfall threshold (mm) to determine if there is free water on the leaf surface.

@note For the complex calculation, the boundaries are included in the upper or lower boundaries, i.e., rhlim will be set to 1 and 80% will be set to 0. For the simple calculation, rhlim is included in the upper boundary, i.e., rhlim will be set to 1 and anything > rhlim will be set to 0. For the rainlim, anything > rainlim will be set to 1.

Value

A numeric vector of leaf wetness values for use with Rc_wet.
